title: pilosella × variifurca
intro: Pilosella × variifurca, commonly known as the hybrid of Pilosella officinarum and Pilosella aurantiaca, is a rare and unique plant species. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella × variifurca include its ability to treat conditions such as digestive issues, fever, and skin problems, as well as its potential to inhibit cancer cell growth. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
